# {{PROJECT_NAME}} - CMakeLists.txt
# Generated by ZuesEngine Editor
# Supports both DLL (hot-reload) and EXE (standalone) builds

cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.10)
project({{PROJECT_NAME}} VERSION 1.0.0)

set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 23)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)

# Build mode: DLL for hot-reload in editor, EXE for standalone game
option(BUILD_AS_DLL "Build as DLL for editor hot-reload" OFF)

# Source files - add your .cpp files here
set(PROJECT_SOURCES
    {{PROJECT_NAME}}.cpp
    # Add more source files here:
    # MySystem.cpp
    # MyComponent.cpp
)

# ============================================================================
# BUILD CONFIGURATION
# ============================================================================

if(BUILD_AS_DLL)
    # Build as shared library (DLL) for hot-reload
    add_library(GameDLL SHARED ${PROJECT_SOURCES})
    target_compile_definitions(GameDLL PRIVATE GAME_DLL_EXPORTS)
    set_target_properties(GameDLL PROPERTIES
        RUNTIME_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../Builds"
        LIBRARY_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../Builds"
    )
    set(TARGET_NAME GameDLL)
    message(STATUS "Building ${PROJECT_NAME} as DLL for hot-reload")
else()
    # Build as standalone executable
    add_executable(${PROJECT_NAME} WIN32 ${PROJECT_SOURCES})
    set_target_properties(${PROJECT_NAME} PROPERTIES
        RUNTIME_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../Builds"
    )
    set(TARGET_NAME ${PROJECT_NAME})
    message(STATUS "Building ${PROJECT_NAME} as standalone EXE")
endif()

# ============================================================================
# ENGINE PATHS - Auto-configured by ZuesEngine Editor
# ============================================================================

# Engine include directories
if(NOT ENGINE_INCLUDE_DIR)
    set(ENGINE_INCLUDE_DIR "{{ENGINE_INCLUDE_DIR}}")
endif()

if(NOT GLFW_INCLUDE_DIR)
    set(GLFW_INCLUDE_DIR "{{GLFW_INCLUDE_DIR}}")
endif()

if(NOT GLAD_INCLUDE_DIR)
    set(GLAD_INCLUDE_DIR "{{GLAD_INCLUDE_DIR}}")
endif()

target_include_directories(${TARGET_NAME} PRIVATE
    ${ENGINE_INCLUDE_DIR}
    ${ENGINE_INCLUDE_DIR}/..
    ${GLFW_INCLUDE_DIR}
    ${GLAD_INCLUDE_DIR}
)

# ============================================================================
# LINKING
# ============================================================================

# Link ZuesEngine DLL
if(NOT ZUES_ENGINE_LIB)
    set(ZUES_ENGINE_LIB "{{ZUES_ENGINE_LIB}}")
endif()

if(EXISTS "${ZUES_ENGINE_LIB}")
    target_link_libraries(${TARGET_NAME} PRIVATE ${ZUES_ENGINE_LIB})
else()
    # Try to find in common locations
    find_library(ZUES_ENGINE_FOUND
        NAMES ZuesEngine
        PATHS
            "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../../Engine/cmake-build-debug/bin"
            "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../../bin"
    )
    if(ZUES_ENGINE_FOUND)
        target_link_libraries(${TARGET_NAME} PRIVATE ${ZUES_ENGINE_FOUND})
    else()
        message(WARNING "ZuesEngine library not found!")
    endif()
endif()

# Platform-specific libraries
if(WIN32)
    target_link_libraries(${TARGET_NAME} PRIVATE opengl32 Ws2_32 Gdi32 winmm)
elseif(APPLE)
    find_library(OpenGL_LIBRARY OpenGL)
    target_link_libraries(${TARGET_NAME} PRIVATE ${OpenGL_LIBRARY})
elseif(UNIX)
    target_link_libraries(${TARGET_NAME} PRIVATE GL X11 pthread Xrandr Xi dl)
endif()

# ============================================================================
# POST-BUILD: Copy DLLs
# ============================================================================

if(WIN32 AND NOT BUILD_AS_DLL)
    # Copy ZuesEngine.dll to output directory for standalone builds
    add_custom_command(TARGET ${TARGET_NAME} POST_BUILD
        COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -E copy_if_different
            "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../../bin/ZuesEngine.dll"
            "$<TARGET_FILE_DIR:${TARGET_NAME}>"
        COMMENT "Copying ZuesEngine.dll to output directory"
    )
endif()
